provenance.note: Disciplinare zone: entire territory of Barbaresco, Neive, Treiso, PLUS the frazione «San Rocco Seno d'Elvio» (Senodelvio) — historically part of comune Barbaresco, later aggregated to comune Alba.

footprint_treatment.alba_frazione_policy: EXCLUDE the comune of Alba from the footprint. Only the small frazione San Rocco Seno d'Elvio of Alba is in the DOCG; ISTAT's comuni layer has no sub-comune (frazione) geometry, and unioning the WHOLE of Alba (a large comune containing the town of Alba and much non-Barbaresco land) would grossly over-approximate. Footprint = union of Barbaresco + Neive + Treiso. Documented under-approximation of the frazione sliver — flagged for owner review; MGA geometry (Option C) is the precise upgrade path.
footprint_treatment.recommended_review: Owner confirms Alba-exclusion, or supplies frazione/MGA geometry for precision.
